hooks.name: git-push-review
hooks.description:
Reviews shell commands before execution to catch potentially destructive git operations

Migration note: Tool categories were converted to the tool-name matcher `^(execute_bash|execute_pwsh|control_bash_process|control_pwsh_process|list_processes|get_process_output)$`, reconstructed from the built-in tool list. Confirm it covers the tools you meant, then enable the hook.

action.prompt: A shell command is about to be executed. If this is a git push or other potentially destructive operation, verify that: 1) All tests pass, 2) Code has been reviewed, 3) Commit messages are clear, 4) The target branch is correct. If it's a routine command, proceed without comment.
